premises: High configurational entropy in HEA-NPs causes severe lattice distortion
Lattice distortion raises atomic diffusion barriers (sluggish diffusion)
Sluggish diffusion suppresses segregation and phase separation under thermal stress
Binary alloy nanoparticles lack such extensive lattice distortions and exhibit faster diffusion
HEA-NPs therefore retain uniform elemental distribution and stable size at high temperature, unlike binary NPs
